summary: Affected-path adjudication confirmed the due-day and evidence/check invalidation corrections. It found one remaining licensing fallback defect in the pinned modelTask: a different criterion in the same document was mistaken for original-source text availability. Root subsequently changed that predicate during review; preliminary rerun withheld text, but this report preserves the supported pinned-source finding for final focused adjudication.
coverage: Start/end SHA-256 comparison of all 32 actual fix-review-source.json pins; all matched at start. Initial review reports preserved.

modelTask current/historical requirement projection, source-document fallback, list_tasks, workspaceContext, and get_requirement related task-title projection; source identity verified against real TSC document/locator construction.

Read new mobile/completed/link-remove/reassignment browser regression and unchanged key-based task/requirement draft/capability paths. Inspected explicit search aria-label and two-line legacy date display addendum.

findings.mechanism: The pinned fallback marked sourceTextAvailable whenever any available licensed linked/historical node shared the source documentId. A legacy task containing criterion CC6.1 text but linked only to CC6.2 therefore skipped conservative source withholding: both criteria share the same TSC document, while only CC6.2 fragments were redacted. Its retained CC6.1 narrative/checklist remained exposed without model-use permission.
findings.evidence: The pinned modelTask used only node.citation.documentId === task.source?.documentId to set sourceTextAvailable. TSC ingestion uses one TSC_DOCUMENT with distinct criterion citation locators (packages/frameworks/src/ingest/tsc.ts:115). First pure in-memory fixture with original locator CC6.1, available node locator CC6.2, recognized AICPA source document, and Claude mode/no permission returned original_description_exposed=true, original_checklist_exposed=true, list_tasks_exposes_title=true, runtime_context_exposes_text=true. Existing frozen licensing regressions covered missing/nonlicensed nodes but not another licensed node from the same document. Root applied a locator predicate after this result; subsequent synthetic projections returned leak=false, which is preliminary counterevidence against the later source rather than the original pinned bytes.
findings.recommendation: Identify the exact original source unit with a nonempty matching citation locator (and applicable page/provenance identity), rather than document identity alone. Use conservative fallback when that identity cannot be established. Verify the frozen final predicate with different-criterion/same-document and missing-locator fixtures across all three model-visible task projections.

limitations: This is affected-path adjudication with inherited first-pass findings, not a fresh independent review.

Read-only inspection and synthetic in-memory checks only; integration lead owns browser/integration test execution. No build, browser, server, network/model call, Git operation, or source write was performed by this reviewer.
